title: Hatsune Miku — Wrapped Up In Your Emotions〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're having another serious talk today...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, they've been having brainstorming sessions each day before they start practicing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
They're so motivated.
Now I'm really looking forward to seeing their performance.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, isn't there anything we can do to help them? What if we brought them snacks and stuff like that other time?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... Unfortunately, we've already gone through everything we had.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I know! What if we played them some songs of encouragement while they're on break?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's a wonderful idea. I'm sure they'll enjoy listening to some relaxing music when they're feeling tired.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Speaking of relaxing, brewing some of that herbal tea they brought over the other day should also work, no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You work like you mean it and rest like you mean it. Switching gears properly should help them concentrate better.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right. Let's see if we have anything else aside from the tea too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright! In the meantime, I'm gonna come up with some good songs to play!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They're all trying to come up with good ideas for Ichika and the girls...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Is there anything I can do for them right now...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? Was that a light bulb, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, I don't know if this counts...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But when we told them that we're excited for their show, they looked really motivated.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! They all had this shine in their eyes☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It is easier to work hard when you know that others are looking forward to seeing you succeed.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. It's important to sit back and believe in them, but we can give them words of encouragement too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Then, let's also do that!
For example, we could...
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are we all ready now?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, I need a little more time.
I'm still not fully tuned.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case, I'm gonna have some of that tea MEIKO brought over for us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's got a nice cool flavor to it. Feels like it helps me focus!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That would be the peppermint tea, I think. I have to think she put quite a lot of thought into her choice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, they've all been supporting us in a lot of different ways. They've even been playing smooth jazz and stuff for us during our breaks...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We need to make sure we pay back their generosity.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, thanks for waiting! Let's get started...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi and the others are all here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, and they're hard at work again today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, Miku-P, isn't now our chance?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Remember what we talked about the other day?! We're gonna support them from afar, right?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Now's definitely our chance!
Here, stand next to the door!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A-Alright, don't push.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(I couldn't really say no...
But we're really going to do that now?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I don't really have a choice, huh...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Then...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (A gentle smile that conveys my faith in them, while also sending vibes of encouragement and expectation...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Wow, Miku-P, that's perfect!
Keep going! Just like that!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How do you feel about that last run...? Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku's looking our way...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. What do you think she's doing?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Does she want to talk to us? No, maybe not.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if she's trying to say, “Hey, you girls better be working in there”, like a teacher checking up on their club!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I seriously doubt that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But seeing her watching us does make me want to keep trying my best for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! So, let's show her that we're working really hard!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright, let's go over what we just did.
For the first part leading up to the chorus...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Umm... I don't know what they're saying, but they do seem a little more motivated now...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Way to go, Miku-P☆)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They're working hard on their music like we expected.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to see your performance, girls.
